name: config_drift
description: Detect config drift: env vars / DB tables / services in code but missing from .env.example, docker-compose.yml. No index required (pure regex). After fixing, re-run to verify. Pairs with exception_guard as quality gate.

workspace_dir.description: REQUIRED: Absolute path to the project root directory.

file.description: File to check (relative to workspace_dir). Omit to scan all source files.
